### The Cost of Complaining
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/the-cost-of-complaining.html
Passage: Numbers 11:1
Points:
- Grumbling has no place in the Christian life because it reveals an underlying lack of gratitude.
- Despite witnessing God's miraculous deliverance, Israel soon grew dissatisfied with His daily provision.
- Discontentment and unbelief inevitably bring spiritual consequences into the believer's journey.
- Believers redeemed by the blood of Christ must respond to God's guidance with thankfulness rather than complaint.

### When We Have Manna, but We Want Meat
Author: Deidre Braley
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/when-we-have-manna-but-we-want-meat-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Numbers 11:1-6
Points:
- Human nature easily overlooks abundant daily blessings by fixating on what is missing.
- A craving for variety among a small group quickly spread discontent across the entire assembly.
- Belittling God's provision dishonors Him, saps spiritual strength, and discourages those around us.
- Choosing active gratitude can be just as contagious as complaint and redirects hearts toward God's goodness.
